command:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin main
git reset --hard origin/main
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
cd projects/kobra2-neo
uv sync --frozen >/dev/null
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/kobra-flow-smoke.XXXXXX)
START=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic())')
uv run kobra-plot prepare samples/svg/curve-demo.svg -o "$TMP/job"
SHA=$(python3 - "$TMP/job/report.json" <<'PY'
import json, sys
r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
assert r['execution']['allowed'] is False
assert r['safety']['valid'] is True
assert r['profile']['pen_up_z'] == 4.97
assert r['profile']['pen_down_z'] == 2.97
assert r['profile']['motion']['travel_feed'] == 6000.0
assert r['profile']['motion']['draw_feed'] == 2400.0
assert r['profile']['motion']['z_feed'] == 360.0
print(r['artifacts']['gcode_sha256'])
PY
)
uv run kobra-live "$TMP/job/output.gcode" --report "$TMP/job/report.json" --profile config/kobra2_neo_pen.toml --expect-sha256 "$SHA" --validate-only
END=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.monotonic())')
ELAPSED=$(python3 - "$START" "$END" <<'PY'
import sys
print(f'{float(sys.argv[2])-float(sys.argv[1]):.3f}')
PY
)
echo RESULT:READY_TO_PRINT elapsed_seconds=$ELAPSED source=samples/svg/curve-demo.svg sha256=$SHA
